title: ADR-018: Spec cache + progress bar surfacing

done: Two fetch sites: IntegrationHeader.jsx:66-67 (dual) and SpecInput.jsx:275 (single)
No caching layer; no progress surfacing beyond a small button spinner

steps.description: Build src/lib/spec-cache.js: localStorage-backed cache with TTL (24h), size guard (3.5MB per entry), LRU eviction on quota-exceeded. API: { get(url), put(url, content), purge() }. Keys prefixed apidiff:spec:<sha1(url)>. All errors swallowed internally (cache must never break the app).
steps.done_condition: get/put/purge exposed; quota-exceeded path triggers LRU eviction; oversized entries skip cache silently

steps.description: Build src/lib/fetch-spec.js: wraps base44.functions.invoke('proxyFetch', ...) with cache check + progress callback. Signature: fetchSpec(url, { onProgress, signal }) -> Promise<string>. Emits cache-lookup → cache-hit|fetching → parsing → caching → done stages. Throws typed SpecFetchError on failure.
steps.done_condition: fetchSpec handles hit and miss paths; progress callback fires for each stage

steps.description: Build src/components/diff/FetchProgress.jsx: sticky banner with provider-gradient bar + stage label row. Props { stages: [{ id, label, status }], accentColor, onDismiss }. Status: pending | in-progress | complete | error. Auto-dismiss on all-complete after 600ms.
steps.done_condition: component renders with sample stage array; transitions pending→in-progress→complete; auto-dismisses after completion

steps.description: Rewire IntegrationHeader.handleCompare to use fetchSpec sequentially with a per-stage onProgress callback. Replace the Promise.all pattern with: fetchSpec(v1.url) → fetchSpec(v2.url) → onLoadSpecs(...). Progress state lifts up via a new prop `onProgress` that DiffViewer wires into <FetchProgress />.
steps.done_condition: picking two versions + click Load shows live FetchProgress; cached fetches flash cache-hit state and dismiss quickly

steps.description: Rewire SpecInput URL-mode fetch (line ~275) to use fetchSpec with the same onProgress wiring. Single-fetch flow: one progress stage + parse stage.
steps.done_condition: pasting a URL in SpecInput shows FetchProgress; cached URLs return instantly with cache-hit flash

steps.description: Add 'Clear spec cache' action to src/pages/settings/*: button calls specCache.purge() and shows toast confirming N entries cleared + bytes freed.
steps.done_condition: settings page exposes clear-cache button; clicking reports cleared count

steps.description: Run bun run typecheck, bun run lint, hex analyze . — primary adapter only; no domain/port changes expected.
